settings.intro: T-shirt Booyah makes funny shirts for people who read too much, root for the Midwest, and laugh at their own jokes. Book carts, marching bands, the humanities: if it's a little nerdy or quirky, then it has a home here.

settings.heading: Who's behind this
settings.text:
Hi, I'm Eric, some rando in Iowa. I like llamas, I raise blueberries at Blueyah Blueberry Farm, and I make art with my 3D printer, which you can find in my Etsy shop.

Oh, and I design fun t-shirts. That's this place.

settings.heading: How the shirts are made
settings.text:
The first T-shirt Booyah shirts were hand-printed. These days each one is printed when you order it, by Printful, on a soft Bella+Canvas 3001 tee in sizes S to 3XL.

Printing to order means no warehouse full of unsold shirts, and I can offer each design in a few colors picked to suit it.

settings.heading: Say hi
settings.text: A question about an order, an idea for a shirt, or a pun you need to get off your chest? Email hello@tshirtbooyah.com or use the contact form.
